name: Feruano Lir Lanahime
original_name: フェルアノ・リル・ラナハイム
source: Kreis older sister. She appears so beautiful to eyes of man that word of her beauty travels to neighboring countries, she is called woman of dangerous beauty. Ferunano has high sense of victory, and her pride won't allow for defeat until Ranhaim Kingdom attains status equal to other countries. She taught Kreis that it takes preparation and pride to be true king.
